description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class for testing data access object (DAO) methods related to job titles in the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management System. It includes setup for test data, various test cases for retrieving, deleting, and counting job titles, and references to external classes and fixtures.

classes.name: JobTitleDaoTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case class for testing the JobTitleDao data access object, focusing on job title retrieval, deletion, and counting functionalities within the HRM system.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment by creating an instance of JobTitleDao and populating test data from a fixture file.

methods.name: testGetJobTitleList
methods.description: Tests retrieving a list of job titles and verifies the correctness and expected count.

methods.name: testGetJobTitlesForEmployee
methods.description: Tests retrieving job titles assigned to specific employees and verifies the correctness of the list.

methods.name: testGetJobTitleListWithInactiveJobTitles
methods.description: Tests retrieving job titles including inactive ones when specified.

methods.name: testDeleteJobTitle
methods.description: Tests the deletion of specific job titles and verifies the number of deletions.

methods.name: testGetJobTitleById
methods.description: Tests fetching a job title by its ID and verifies the retrieved object and its name.

methods.name: testGetJobSpecAttachmentById
methods.description: Tests retrieving job specification attachment by ID and verifies the file name.

methods.name: testGetJobTitles
methods.description: Tests retrieving job titles with and without filters, verifying counts and correctness.

methods.name: testGetJobTitlesCount
methods.description: Tests counting job titles with and without filters, verifying the correctness of counts.
